rationale:
Issue #65 reports that IkigaJSONEncoder emits raw control characters (e.g. "%0F".removingPercentEncoding!) producing invalid JSON, and expects \u000f as Foundation's JSONEncoder does. The minimized production patch is exactly the one behavioral hunk in Sources/_NIOJSON/Types/JSONArray.swift that adds a `case 0x00..<0x20` branch to the string-escaping switch, rewriting the byte as \u00XX with lowercase hex. Automatic minimization dropped the only unrelated hunk (a trailing-whitespace-only edit at line ~75), leaving no refactor, formatting, feature, doc, config, or test change in the production patch. The trigger is the upstream test from the same fixing commit, testEncodeEscaping, which encodes "Hello\n %0F".removingPercentEncoding! and asserts round-trip equality, byte equality with Foundation JSONEncoder, and presence of the literal \u000f. Every API it uses (IkigaJSONEncoder, JSONEncoder/JSONDecoder, removingPercentEncoding) already exists on the buggy revision, so the FAIL_TO_PASS is a behavioral assertion failure rather than a fix-only-symbol compile error; strict evidence confirms build.both_versions PASS, trigger.buggy_differential reproducing only this selector, trigger.fixed_clean, deterministic over 3 repetitions, and fixed full suite green, both pre- and post-minimization. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, and traceability is fix_commit -> merged PR #66 -> issue #65, matching the single allowed root cause id.

Issue #65 reports that IkigaJSONEncoder emits raw control characters (e.g. U+000F from "%0F".removingPercentEncoding!) producing invalid JSON, and states the expected output is \u000f. The retained production hunk in Sources/_NIOJSON/Types/JSONArray.swift adds exactly that missing escape path: a `case 0x00..<0x20` branch that rewrites the byte as a \u00XX sequence during string escaping. The trigger test testEncodeEscaping encodes "Hello\n %0F".removingPercentEncoding!, round-trips it, compares byte output against Foundation's JSONEncoder, and asserts the payload contains \\u000f, which is the same symptom and same expected result as the issue. Traceability is fix_commit -> merged PR #66 (body: closes issue 65) -> issue #65, with verified_fix_issue_numbers=[65]. Minimization dropped hunk 1, which was a pure trailing-whitespace change at JSONArray.swift line ~75, and retained only hunk 2; the remaining diff has no refactor, feature extension, doc, config, or test content. The trigger uses only APIs present on the buggy revision (IkigaJSONEncoder, Foundation JSONEncoder/JSONDecoder, removingPercentEncoding), so it is a behavioral, not fix-only-API, failure. Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization runs reports build.both_versions PASS, trigger.buggy_differential reproducing Tests/IkigaJSONTests/JSONTests.swift::testEncodeEscaping, trigger.fixed_clean PASS, trigger.deterministic across 3 repetitions, and full_suite.fixed_all_green with no failed checks. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so #65 is not a duplicate.
